detail.longDescription: Your agent reads pages one HTML at a time. This catalog reads like a file index: every dataset has free sample CSV and JSON at a stable URL, and llms.txt at the site root lists the whole catalog, schema, row counts, and the MCP install line in one machine-readable block. Point any MCP client at npx --allow-git=all -y github:jayjex/dataset-mcp and the same rows become queryable. Index: https:// jayjex.github.io/data-vault/ll ms.txt # llmstxt # AIAgents
